title: Wildcard (YC W25) Is Hiring a Founding Engineer
summary: Wildcard is a Y Combinator Winter 2025 batch startup seeking a Founding Engineer to join their early-stage team. As a founding engineer, this role involves building the core product and infrastructure from the ground up, requiring broad technical expertise and entrepreneurial mindset.
problem_solved: Helps Wildcard scale their technical team and build core infrastructure during critical early growth stage.
why_valuable: Founding engineer roles offer significant equity upside, direct impact on product direction, and the opportunity to shape company culture and technical decisions at a YC-backed startup.
